Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.03 fixes the c05 hardship food-aid visit: Eleanor now arrives with a zero budget like vanilla Eleanor4, so any accepted food is a real donation and always plays the thank-you branch; previously store budget modifiers could give her credits, turn the gift into a purchase and trigger the refusal line. It also includes the 1.02 late-route response choices, the 1.01 Upper Level customer eligibility fix and a dialogue/whitespace polish pass. 1.03 修复第6章（c05）困境求食来访：埃莉诺现在与原版 Eleanor4 一样以 0 预算到店，任何收下的食物都算真实援助并必定播放道谢分支；此前店铺预算加成会让她带着钱“买下”食物，导致误播拒绝台词。同时包含 1.02 的后期回应选择、1.01 的上层顾客判定修复与一轮对白／留白整理。 1.02 adds late-route response choices across the harem, Eleanor, maid and revolution routes (dr07, dr09, dr14, c18, R14, m24), suppresses the ordinary-route landfill assist in the dual route, and includes the pending 1.01 Upper Level customer eligibility fix. 1.02 增加后宫线、埃莉诺线、侍从线和革命军线的后期回应选择（dr07、dr09、dr14、c18、R14、m24），在后宫线停用普通恋爱线的拾荒协助，并包含待发布的 1.01 上层顾客判定修复。 1.01 extends the harem showcase ornaments' Upper Level customer rule from three whitelisted IDs to all Upper Level buyers, including SELLNBUY customers such as the water stockpiler. Story clients, native Eleanor's scripted appearances and other mods remain excluded. 1.01 将后宫线橱窗饰品的上层顾客判定从三个白名单ID扩展到所有上层买家，包括囤水者等 SELLNBUY 顾客；具名剧情、原版埃莉诺剧情和其他MOD客户仍排除。 1.00 fixes the dual-route cooperation scene using Eleanor's scavenger portrait after she has already returned to Upper Level work in dr08. The common-route chapter 21 keeps the scavenger outfit; the dual coop visit now uses her Upper Level portrait. 1.00 修复后宫线合作采购场景在她已于 dr08 回到上层工作后仍使用拾荒者画像的问题；普通线第 21 章仍使用拾荒装，后宫线的合作来访改用上层装。 0.99 stops the dual route from showing the ordinary-route "A complete romance route has been reached" notification when the core is completed at dr11. The dual ending page still appears at dr20, and the meta unlock behavior is unchanged. 0.99 修复后宫线在 dr11 核心完成时误弹普通线“完整恋爱线已达成”提示的问题；后宫结局页仍在 dr20 正常显示，meta 解锁逻辑不变。 0.98 shortens the three harem showcase ornament descriptions to one sentence of effect values while keeping their flavor lines: the plaque has a 50% daily chance to refer one Upper Level customer (minimum 2 days apart), the patron ornament gives +30% final budget, and the gratitude ornament gives an extra 10% tip on real purchases, capped at 150 per visit. 0.98 将后宫线三件橱窗饰品的效果描述各压缩为一句数值说明，保留原有风味描述：铭牌每个营业日50%机会引荐1位上层买家（最短间隔2天）；座饰使最终预算+30%；银饰在实际付款后额外给10%小费、每访最多150。 0.97 lowers the dual-route Upper Level reputation checkpoints from 50/100/150 to 30/60/90 so the stages can be reached before the main story ends. The checkpoints still latch once reached, spend no reputation, and keep the same rewards and waiting dailies. 0.97 将后宫线上层区声望检查点由50/100/150下调为30/60/90，使主线通关前能走完各阶段；仍然达标即锁存、不扣声望，奖励与等待日常不变。 0.96 shortens the dual-route top notifications to roughly the length of the revolution supply tips: the waiting-gate reputation progress is now just "Upper Level reputation: X / Y"; the checkpoint, reward, ending and full-showcase notices each keep one short clause. 0.96 将后宫线顶部提示压缩到与革命军补给提示相近的长度：等待期只显示“上层区声望：X／Y”，检查点、奖励、结局与橱窗已满提示各保留一句短句。 0.95 restores Lydia's missing matchmaking setup in the dual entry: the written dr01_notice offer ("I can help you") was never appended to the dialogue, so the player chose "teach me a few lines" before hearing her offer. It is now played before the entry choice. dr04 adds a short serious coaching beat before the confession, and dr05 opens with Eleanor mentioning that Lydia keeps pushing her to hear the player out, so "did she teach you that?" no longer arrives out of nowhere. 0.95 修复双恋入口没有播放莉迪亚“我可以帮你一把”的僚机提议——该段早已写好却从未接入对白，导致玩家在没听到提议前就直接选择“那你教我几句”；现在会先播放该段再进入选择。dr04 增加莉迪亚教玩家“别让她猜”的短段，dr05 开场由埃莉诺提到莉迪亚一直在劝她听玩家说，使“这句也是她教的？”不再突兀。 0.94 adds Lydia as a real Upper Level buyer in four dual-route scenes (dr04, dr07, dr09, dr10) and in her post-route daily visit. After the written conversation she buys luxury, art and high-end stock with a 500-credit budget (300 for the daily) through the native offer/bargain flow; dialogue and trade happen in the same visit, she never sells, and the closing line differs depending on whether she actually bought anything. 0.94 让莉迪亚在双恋线四个场景（dr04、dr07、dr09、dr10）和结局后的日常第 2 段中以 500（日常为300）预算实际购买奢侈品／艺术品／高档品，对白与买卖在同一次来访完成；她不会卖货，并按是否成交播放不同收尾。 0.93 fixes the friend-route post-ending visits: the same friend daily was queued up to five times as a pure dialogue, so Eleanor repeated the same lines and left without selling anything. Friend epilogue visits are now real sell visits with scavenged goods; the first visit plays the written scene and later visits use a short trade greeting. 0.93 修复朋友线结局后的来访：同一段朋友日常此前最多被排入五次，且只是纯对话，导致埃莉诺重复同样两句、什么也不卖就离开。朋友后日谈来访现在会带搜获货物并进入正常买卖；第一次播放原朋友段，之后使用简短交易问候。 0.92 makes the dual-romance entry option speak in character ("Then teach me a few lines") and moves the route details into the option description. Dual waiting-gate reputation progress is now shown as a top notification instead of a narrator dialogue line. Sophia's approved v3 upper outfit and v4 cream knit home portraits are included; with CutePortraits the new art is used, without it the original femaleUpper3 fallback remains. 0.92 把双恋入口选项改成角色口吻“那你教我几句”，路线信息移入选项说明；双恋等待期的上层区声望进度改为顶部提示，不再作为旁白台词。同步加入索菲娅 v3 上层日常装与 v4 奶油白针织私服定稿；启用少女当铺时使用新图，未启用仍回退 femaleUpper3。0.91 fixes native choice bubbles showing the next NPC branch as the player's option text. Direct AddChoice menus now always insert a player reply node, covering the C08 gift refusal, attendant entry back, protection fallback, locket refusal, reward-later and bail rescue-later choices. 0.91 修复原生选项气泡把下一段 NPC 分支当成玩家选项的问题：所有直接 AddChoice 菜单现在先插入玩家回应节点，涵盖 C08 回礼婉拒、侍从入口返回、保护失败 fallback、吊坠婉拒、稍后领取与保释后再救选项。0.90 implements the 13-event revolution route R01/R02/R04-R14: supply accumulation at G1=400, G2=1000 and G3=1800, repeatable supply and loot visits while gates wait, the R06/R14 morning visits, the R12-R13 departure interval, and the immediate E9 “I Want to See You” ending page. Old eight-visit route C saves resume at the nearest new stage without retroactive completion. 0.90 实装革命军线13次事件 R01/R02/R04—R14：补给累计 G1=400／G2=1000／G3=1800，门槛等待期间保留补给与战利品来访，R06/R14 清晨来访、R12—R13 出发间隔，以及 R14 后立即显示的 E9《我想见你》结局页。旧八次丙线存档按最近阶段续接，不追溯授予完成。 0.89 replaces the attendant and shared-romance ending CGs with approved blue-violet/coral pixel artwork. Immediate E3/E4 pages show the complete proportional image above separate ending text. 0.89 正式替换侍从线与后宫线像素风结局CG，即时结局页改为上方完整等比图片、下方文字。 0.88 keeps Lydia's independent portrait: a romance lead must not become a generic NPC. Without CutePortraits, Lydia uses er_portrait_lydia_female_vanilla and the date-outfit vanilla variant; Mother falls back to original femaleUpper3. Maid, gala and tactical-vest scenes still reuse original Eleanor portraits. Lydia only falls back to femaleUpper10 if her custom file is missing. 0.87's generic Lydia fallback is replaced. E3/E4 standalone ending pages and the short attendant entry UI are retained. 0.88 保留Lydia独立形象：恋爱对象不能改成通用NPC。未启用少女当铺时，Lydia 继续使用 er_portrait_lydia_female_vanilla 与约会服独立画像；母亲回退原游戏 femaleUpper3；女仆、礼服、战术背心仍复用原游戏 Eleanor 画像。只有Lydia自定义文件缺失时才回退 femaleUpper10。0.87 的通用NPC回退已替换；E3/E4 独立结局页与侍从短入口保留。0.87 adds ultimate portrait compatibility, immediate E3/E4 standalone ending pages and a short attendant entry UI. 0.86 balances expression changes, fixes 1x1 ornament hit areas, corrects price verdicts, restores C03 appended scenes and the 800-credit savings progress/tip, and changes the C08 paid gift to an electronic component. 0.85 replaces 17 Eleanor expression placeholders and the attendant ending CG with generated artwork, aligned to the beautified base portraits. 0.86 平衡表情变化、修复饰品点击与价格判定、恢复调查款进度提示，并把C08付款回礼改为电子元件。0.85 替换17张埃莉诺表情与侍从结局CG，表情与美化底图对齐。 Eleanor and Lydia story expansion with explicit romance choices and Upper Level reputation checkpoints at 30/60/90. Three owned showcase ornaments independently provide referrals, +30% buyer budget and 10% extra tips capped at 150 per visit. Includes waiting dailies, original story rewards, legacy-save compatibility, improved dialogue and gift handling, a closing-time finale and updated portraits. 0.84 adds compatibility with game 1.0.0.14 so the story and the 0-point "Early Recall" starting perk register again. 0.83 revises the script to the final no-narrator version, adds expression portraits with per-line switching and E3/E4 ending pages. Chinese/English. 埃莉诺与莉迪亚剧情扩展：上层声望30/60/90检查点、明确的恋爱选择和三件1格橱窗饰品，分别提供引荐客、预算+30%及每访最多150的额外小费。包含等待日常、原剧情奖励与旧档兼容，优化人物动机、章节衔接及回礼结算，调整关门后的晚会终章，并更新埃莉诺与莉迪亚画像。0.84 兼容游戏 1.0.0.14，重新启用剧情和 0 点“旧日回想”开局特性；0.83 按最终无旁白稿修订文本，新增表情立绘逐句切换与 E3/E4 结局页。中英同步。
